Definition
[Hyperbolic system] 1. ch7:7.3.1-def-1\group Hyperbolic Systems The system of PDE (1) is called hyperbolic if the $m \times m$ matrix $\mathbf{B}(x, t; y)$ is diagonalizable for each $x, y \in \mathbb {R}^n$, $t \geq 0$.
